name: wood-domains
notes: Plank wood as oriented angular domains: coarse Worley patches each filled with elongated sub-cells aligned to the patch's own grain direction. Growth rings were tried and rejected - a ring bullseye is the worst-case iconic motif for a non-rotating dual mask, recurring visibly along the stroke. Levels 30/55/80 = light/medium/heavy, calibrated to core-band stroke coverage by tools/fractal-tip.mjs --calibrate; verified by tools/spectrum-audit.mjs. REVISED to a tonal mask (maskMode tonal): the tip carries the tone-mapped field itself rather than a threshold cut, value-curve deconvolved by the mask train's overlap (v = 1-(depth*damage)^(1/n)); the level number is now the damage/modulation DEPTH, not coverage - moderate damage renders as moderate contrast over intact paint. SPLOTCH fix on review (dark/light discs at stroke width): the mask train is now near-rigid - dual scatter 0.7->0.2, so the per-point stamp count n is deterministic and the composite tone v^n stops wandering at stamp scale; the field is high-passed above 1.4 c/dia (spec highpassK) so no stamp tints its whole footprint; tonal masks skip the 1/H spectral pre-comp (a near-rigid train transfers the tip spectrum directly).
